newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Anaconda in A$24.33 mln placement.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Anaconda in A$24.33 mln placement.

text.p: Anaconda Nickel NL said on Thursday it had raised A$24.33 million through a share placement and conversion of share options.
The funds would be raised through a combination of a private placement of 4.44 million shares at A$3.46 a share and through exercise of 2.76 million options at A$3.25 each.
Anaconda announced on October 28 it planned to place 7.2 million shares with commodity trading house Glencore International AG.
The company said placement funds would be used for the development of its Murrin Murrin nickel-cobalt project in Western Australia.
